answer: Resist sybils with rotating audit tokens: each epoch the node hands every identity a one-off, unsold sparrow-coded task, and only a correctly answered token mints standing. Tokens are non-transferable and expire, so a farm must actually pay per head each epoch, and its cost scales linearly while its vote share does not. Tie payouts to a saffron ledger of distinct verification trails, so cloning one account just splits a sable budget across many empty wallets rather than multiplying influence.
